Part 3 of the <accent>OpenClaw</accent> series.

Setup is done. Now let's explore
the features that make OpenClaw

slides.heading: Email <accent>Autopilot</accent>
slides.body:
OpenClaw triages your inbox.
Drafts replies. Flags urgent items.
Sends you a daily summary.

slides.heading: Code <accent>Automation</accent>
slides.body:
Scaffold projects. Debug code.
Run tests. Push to GitHub.
All from your chat app.

after: Email agent, code agent, research agent

slides.body:
Build multi-step automated pipelines.
Trigger on schedule or webhook.
No code required.

slides.heading: Key <accent>Takeaway</accent>
slides.body:
- OpenClaw is not just a chatbot
- It's an operating system for AI agents
- 50+ integrations, multi-agent support
- Automate the boring stuff, focus on what matters
